integrity: Proof combines a complete finite mod-two boundary-rank computation with the fixed-face Hopf trace formula and semisimple rational character theory. Computation is independently reproducible from embedded code and output. No outside independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Rational homology and the explicitly defined affine subgroup only. No integral torsion, integral group-lattice, equivariant homotopy or full-automorphism classification. Original 2014 journal article full text was inaccessible; publication-priority uncertainty remains.
title: The affine homology representation of the Paley-31 directed flag complex
